info.title: Autonomy API
info.description: The v2 marketer app's API: goals, plans, approvals, batches, decisions, proof, webhooks and the operator's runtime tick.

schema.title: Response List Goals V2 Goals Get

post.description: Store a new goal (a draft) with the Strategist's plan for it, waiting for approval.

get.description: The goal, its latest plan, its content (drafts included) and the proof so far.

post.description: Approve the plan and set the autonomy level; the goal becomes active.
Stop the agent acting for this goal.
Let the agent act again (the plan must be approved).

get.description: The goal's content library, drafts included.

schema.title: Response Goal Content V2 Goals  Goal Id  Content Get

post.description: Approve, reject or retire one content item.

get.description: The latest decisions, newest first, each with its plain-English reason.

schema.title: Response List Decisions V2 Decisions Get

get.description: One customer: their state, and their latest decisions and events.
The latest briefing for a goal (or the whole programme); null when there is none yet.

schema.title: Response Get Briefing V2 Briefing Get

get.description: Agent vs holdout and vs baseline; null when there is nothing to show yet.

schema.title: Response Get Proof V2 Proof Get

get.description: Delivery, complaint and unsubscribe rates over the last week, with open alerts.

schema.title: Response List Alerts V2 Alerts Get

get.description: Goals the agent suggests (drafts); POST one's text to /v2/goals to take it up.

schema.title: Response List Opportunities V2 Opportunities Get

get.description: Contacts held for a person to sign off, newest first; filter by goal and status.

schema.title: Response List Batches V2 Batches Get

post.description: Approve a pending batch; the runtime sends it on its next tick. 409 if it is no longer pending.
Reject a pending batch; nothing in it is sent. 409 if it is no longer pending.
Run one tick of the runtime now (or at `now`). 404 without a runtime, 403 where it is turned off.

A provider callback (delivery, click, reply, ...): 401 on a bad signature, 404 on an unknown channel.

The raw body is passed through untouched, because signatures are computed over the exact bytes.

AudienceFilter.title: AudienceFilter
AudienceFilter.description: A test on one `CustomerState` field. `days_since_*` compare a datetime field with now.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: One plain sentence: who, which channels, which offers

Batch.title: Batch
Batch.description: One goal's ACT decisions from one sweep, held for a person when the goal is at APPROVE level.

uplift.title: Uplift
uplift.description: Change in the chance of the outcome caused by acting, -1..1

value_if_converted.title: Value If Converted
value_if_converted.description: Expected margin (or revenue) if the outcome happens

urgency.title: Urgency
urgency.description: Multiplier; decays as the moment passes

expected_net.title: Expected Net
expected_net.description: uplift x value - offer cost - channel cost, times urgency

uncertainty.title: Uncertainty
uncertainty.description: Std. dev. of expected_net, for sampling

Bid.title: Bid
Bid.description: One goal's offer for this customer's attention. Money is in the goal's currency.

body.title: Body
body.description: Plain English; every number in it appears in `numbers`

numbers.title: Numbers
numbers.description: Computed by code, never by an LLM

Channel.title: Channel
Channel.description: Where a message can go. `WEBHOOK` means "hand the decision to the client's own tool".

version.title: Version
version.description: How many events have been folded in

recent_contacts.title: Recent Contacts
recent_contacts.description: Send times in the last 30 days, oldest first; feeds contacts_7d/30d

active_hours.title: Active Hours
active_hours.description: 24 shares of engagement by local hour, summing to 1; empty if unknown

hour_counts.title: Hour Counts
hour_counts.description: 24 counts of engagement by local hour

offer_sensitivity.title: Offer Sensitivity
offer_sensitivity.description: 0 = buys at full price, 1 = needs an offer

probability.title: Probability
probability.description: Chance the policy had of choosing exactly this

attention_price.title: Attention Price
attention_price.description: What a bid had to beat

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: One plain sentence a marketer understands

bids.title: Bids
bids.description: The top bids considered, best first

max_contacts_per_week.title: Max Contacts Per Week
max_contacts_per_week.description: Hard cap per customer across all goals

quiet_start_hour.title: Quiet Start Hour
quiet_start_hour.description: Local time; no sends from here...

Estimate.title: Estimate
Estimate.description: A number with its 95% interval. Every money figure shown to a person is one of these.

event_id.title: Event Id
event_id.description: Unique; the store drops a second event with the same id

decision_id.title: Decision Id
decision_id.description: The decision that caused it, if any

value.title: Value
value.description: Purchase or refund amount, gross, in the business currency

margin.title: Margin
margin.description: Gross margin of a purchase, if known

text.title: Text
text.description: The marketer's words, e.g. 'win back lapsed customers, $5k this month'

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: Total spend allowed on offers and messages, in `currency`

kind.description: Optional; inferred from the text when absent

objective.description: Optional; the Strategist proposes one when absent

GoalCreate.title: GoalCreate
GoalCreate.description: The marketer's goal in their own words, and what they will spend on it.

Group.title: Group
Group.description: The three-way split every customer belongs to, for proof (plan-v2 section 8).

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Percent for percent_off, money for amount_off

cost_per_redemption.title: Cost Per Redemption
cost_per_redemption.description: Expected cost to the business if used

incremental_revenue.description: Agent vs holdout, per the agent group

lift_vs_baseline.description: Agent vs simple baseline, profit per customer

now.title: Now
now.description: When the tick runs; the API's clock if absent

acts.title: Acts
acts.description: Of those, decisions to contact someone

queued.title: Queued
queued.description: Messages queued for a later send time

batches.title: Batches
batches.description: Batches created by this tick, waiting for a person

TickResult.title: TickResult
TickResult.description: What one runtime tick did: counts, plus the batches it created and the alerts it raised in full.

accepted.title: Accepted
accepted.description: How many of the callback's events were new
